column1: # Deliberate differences from Yomitan d3c54c1, read by tools/check-yomitan.mjs.

column7: Yomitan matches a phrasal-verb particle or preposition as a prefix of the next word (looked uptown -> look uptown); the pack matches whole words (section 7.3).
Yomitan matches a phrasal-verb particle or preposition as a prefix of the next word (looked uptown -> look uptown); the pack matches whole words (section 7.3).

The engine never returns an empty text (35e2dab's deinflect_recursive stops at one, and no dictionary has an empty headword); Yomitan returns it when a rule consumes the whole text (s -> "" via plural).
Yomitan matches an interposed-object particle as a prefix of the next word (put it upon -> put upon); the pack matches whole words (section 7.3).
